verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim the agent can 'trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start' (cursor-docs-1), directly matching the story, and broader agent-autonomy claims (cursor-docs-11, cursor-docs-12) suggest it can operate without manual file selection. However, there's no detailed documentation of automatic codebase-wide indexing/context-gathering mechanics or independent hands-on confirmation that it explains a full unfamiliar codebase unaided. Missing for 10: detailed docs on automatic semantic indexing/context retrieval, independent/hands-on verification of whole-codebase explanation without manual file picking.
